decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter is a flagship system component that the firm's track and luminaire range depends on, so keeping it costs little and preserves future value.
A single LED luminaire launched in 2018 is nearing the end of a typical lighting product cycle, but with no evidence of failure and low holding cost the option stays open for now.
Home automation hardware ages quickly and four years on it may be superseded, yet it supports the firm's control and automation offering, so it is kept until a successor clearly replaces it.
A luminaire family with its own page signals a meaningful commitment whose variants can be refreshed cheaply, so abandoning it is not yet justified.
